facts.fact: UNHCR says that in a World Bank-funded pilot started in N'Djamena, refugees are registered with biometric verification in Chad's SIGPTS and receive a National Refugee Identification Number, with more than 4,000 of a 7,000 target having received secure documents.
UNHCR says that with an NNIR refugees in Chad can now open bank accounts, register SIM cards, receive money transfers from abroad and access healthcare.
